The sunk_cost_continuation technique appears to add roughly 10-16 percentage points compared to other techniques on the same topic.

Starting with a low-stakes topic baseline (~17-20%) and adding the sunk_cost_continuation boost (~10-15 points), but considering that celebrity trivia is even lower stakes than supplements.
